author: GamingBolt
description:
In Part 2 we discussed the events of Onimusha 2, in this part we will be discussing the events of Onimusha 3. Between the hidden castles, legions of Genma, alternate dimensions hiding powerful treasures, and wondrous technologies, it's clear that Onimusha's take on Sengoku period Japan is on a whole different level. 

With that all in mind, the next mainline title, 2004's Onimusha 3, is perhaps the strangest - and most ambitious - entry yet.
title: Onimusha 3: Demon Siege - The COMPLETE STORY - Before You Play Onimusha Way of the Sword

author: GamingBolt
description:
The Witcher 3 Remastered certainly picked a tricky time to surface, didn’t it? With equally compelling titles already on the cards, deciding to drop another hundred hours into this one isn’t a decision to be taken lightly. 

But simply dipping your toes into an experience as good as this one isn’t an option, as The Continent is designed to draw you into Geralt’s world, and keep you in there until you have nothing more to achieve in it.

So why are we diving back in? We’re happy to tell you why that’s being considered quite seriously within our ranks. Join us on a trip through memory lane seen from the lens of a modernized classic that refuses to fade away into gaming history.
title: The Witcher 3 Remastered - Why I Can’t Wait To Spend Another 100 HOURS

author: GamingBolt
description:
We've been inundated with new details on Grand Theft Auto 6 since the premiere of the Extended Look, as various outlets and content creators visited Rockstar to see the game in action. Granted, this isn't even close to covering everything, yet it highlights the sheer amount of stuff to do, even during something as simple as fast traveling, and how the development team has evolved its own systems to new levels.

Here are 15 new things you should know about Grand Theft Auto 6, which you may need to know before you pre-order.
title: GTA 6 - 15 NEW Gameplay Details You Need To Know Before You Pre-Order (Part 1)
